name: Wand of Freshness

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: Four charges (1d4 + 1 back at dawn): a charge purifies food and drink.
text: This wand has 4 charges and regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges each dawn. While holding it you can spend 1 charge to cast Purify Food and Drink.

powers.name: Purify Food and Drink

params.text: makes the food and drink within 5 feet safe and fresh

powers.text: 1 charge: Purify Food and Drink. (No other effect in the game.)
